canonicalState.aliasRule: One live record owner. Both codec facets reuse identical key/payload wordslots and retain every32bit; shuffled secure views must not be copied or normalized into unrelated records.
canonicalState.representationAuthority: Host tracks ciphertext/plaintext phase; never infer phase from word value.
canonicalState.crossRoleIdentity: Same creature move-mutation module and party-record backing across command,party,resolve andcontinuation facets; no copied codec instances masquerading as game systems.
canonicalState.sessionOwner: One move-learning session owns selectedParty,selectedSlot,candidateMove,result and task lifetime; its creature reference aliases the party record used by every accessor.
